name: Covert Affairs
overview: A young CIA operative, Annie Walker, is mysteriously summoned to headquarters for duty as a field operative. While Annie believes she's been promoted for her exceptional linguistic skills, there may be something or someone from her past that her CIA bosses are really after. Auggie Anderson is a CIA military intelligence agent who was blinded while on assignment and is Annie's guide in this world of bureaucracy, excitement and intrigue.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Meet Annie Walker: smart, stunning and the CIA's newest field operative in one of their most secretive branches. Suddenly summoned by headquarters for active duty one month before training is over, she's quickly thrown into a shadowy world full of cons, killers and international crime rings. What she doesn't know is there's something - or someone - from her past that her bosses want badly enough to put her in harm's way. She just has to survive long enough to find out why.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Annie Walker’s dual life as a CIA operative and sister begins to collide when shocking revelations threaten the secrets she’s fought to protect. As personal loyalties blur with professional duty, she faces choices that could expose her identity and alter every relationship she’s built.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Everything changes for savvy CIA operative Annie Walker in season three of Covert Affairs. Reassigned to a new and even more covert division of the Agency, Annie takes on missions that become personal and finds herself on dangerous forays into inhospitable territory, while a series of explosive revelations forces her to question her role and what (and who) matters most.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Annie Walker faces escalating danger and deception as her missions intertwine with personal loyalties and hidden agendas. When alliances shift and secrets surface across South America, Europe, and Asia, Annie must navigate betrayal within the CIA and confront the consequences of mixing love and espionage.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Months after going off the grid, Annie Walker returns to the CIA carrying a secret that could compromise everything. Tasked with investigating a global terror plot, she’s drawn into an international chase from Venezuela to France while navigating shifting alliances and the enigmatic Ryan McQuaid, whose motives may be as complex as her own.
